offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures oral generic and branded prescription drugs, including abuse-deterrent opioids and other controlled-release products, at its New Jersey facilities. Sells to pharmaceutical marketers, wholesalers and partners, and earns revenue from manufacturing, product sales and licensing.

primary_products.value: abuse-deterrent opioid tablets; generic controlled-release tablets and capsules; generic ADHD and anti-infective drugs; oral prescription drugs

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical distributors, wholesalers, marketing partners and licensees

revenue_model.value: product sales: manufactured generic and branded oral drugs sold to wholesalers and partners; licensing or royalties: license fees and profit share from partnered drug products; project or contract: contract manufacturing and development fees
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures oral dosage drugs from purchased active ingredients, sold to distributors and marketing partners

geography_served.value: US national: Manufactures in New Jersey and sells mainly in the United States, with some licensing partners abroad

specialization.value: related lines: generic drugs, abuse-deterrent branded opioids and contract manufacturing of oral dosage forms

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers and distributors; partners / resellers: licensing and marketing partners that sell its products

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval, manufacturing and controlled substances need FDA and DEA oversight
